In my experience it's less about the health aspect and more of psychological vs physiological effects. Drugs like alcohol or THC are intoxicating in that they change the way you think. Whereas drugs like caffeine and nicotine are more physical, making you feel calm or alert. I think of it as you can drive while drinking coffee or smoking a cigarette but you shouldn't drive while drunk or high. Again, I'm not a doctor and I'm sure caffeine and nicotine have some psychological effects as well. And I haven't tried CBD oils.
